text:
Assistant A better follows the user's explicit instruction to keep the email short and to the point. It is concise, professional, and covers all three requested areas: data analysis, presentation style, and clarity of conclusions. Its weaknesses are minor. It has no subject line, and it assumes the report was for the finance team.

Assistant B is more detailed. Its numbered questions give the supervisor more specific prompts, and its subject line and closing are more complete. However, it runs considerably longer than the "short and to the point" request allows, with extra filler such as the deadline request and the stakeholder sentence. Its added depth does not outweigh the violated length constraint.

Because the user set a clear brevity requirement, Assistant A is the better response.

[[A]]
